info.name: EvolutionaryScale Forge ESM3 Embeddings Generation API

items.docs: Iteratively samples tokens on the requested track of an `ESMProtein` input, filling in masked positions until the track is complete. Wraps encode, iterative sampling, and decode in a single call. Returns a fully populated `ESMProtein`.
Generate multiple proteins concurrently using a list of `ESMProtein` inputs and a parallel list of `GenerationConfig` objects. Returns a list of completed `ESMProtein` results in the same order.
